name: markdown
title: Markdown
description: Renders sanitized content HTML (e.g. body_html from the Medusa content plugin) in a shadcn-themed prose container with Shiki code styling.

name: image-zoom
title: Image Zoom
description: Click-to-zoom full-screen image overlay with gallery navigation: Root, Trigger, and a getImageZoomContextOptional hook that lets nested images (e.g. Gallery.Image) auto-detect an ancestor overlay. Vendored from more-shadcn-svelte (MIT, © 2025 kevwpl).

name: gallery
title: Gallery
description: Compound product image gallery/lightbox on embla: Root (optional thumbnails/thumbnailBreakpoint/zoom props), Main, Carousel, Image, Thumbnails, ThumbnailImage, Dots — sharing a context. Root publishes layout intent to the parts; set `zoom` to enable the click-to-zoom overlay. Accepts image URLs or Medusa image objects.

name: search
title: Search
description: Compound storefront search primitives (Root, Icon, Input, Results, Hit) sharing a context. Root defaults its search fn to the sveltekit-medusa-sdk `search` remote; Results renders products first (headerless) then non-product types under headings, as a dropdown or an in-flow full-page list.

name: search-box
title: Search Box
description: Drop-in navbar search box: full input + live-results dropdown above a configurable breakpoint, collapsing to an icon that links to a search page below it. Assembles the search primitives.

name: search-dialog
title: Search Dialog
description: Command-palette search: Ctrl/Cmd+K opens a centered modal (page behind blurred) with the input autofocused and arrow-key-navigable results. Composes the search primitives inside a shadcn Dialog; drop into your layout.

name: faq
title: FAQ
description: Compound FAQ primitives (Root, Item, Question, Answer) over the shadcn Accordion. Defaults to the stock look; each part is stylable via class. Question exposes a swappable icon snippet + configurable rotate-on-open; Answer renders children (supports {@html}). Loop your own Q&A data over the items.

name: seo
title: SEO
description: Head/metadata primitives for SEO. MetaProvider seeds site-wide defaults (siteName, siteUrl, titleTemplate, twitterHandle) via context; Metadata emits per-page <title>/description/canonical/OpenGraph/Twitter tags off a MetaConfig, merging provider defaults; JsonLd renders a typed schema-dts object as a <script type="application/ld+json"> tag. No env, no state mutation; provider is optional. SSR-safe.

name: review
title: Review
description: Dependency-free presentational atom for a single review: Review (default-exported compound) + Review.Title/Rating/Author/Date/Body, Item (the per-item context provider the collection surfaces loop over), Star, and the per-item context/logic/types the rest of the reviews surfaces build on. Renders from a `review` prop or ambient per-item context; no SDK, no fetching.

name: reviews
title: Reviews
description: Compound review-collection primitives composed over the `review` atom (Star, Review.*): Root, Summary (.Title/.Average/.Stars/.Count/.Histogram(.Bar/.Label)), Sort, List, Pagination (.Prev/.Next/.Info), Carousel, and a submission Form (.Author/.Rating/.Title/.Body/.Submit/.Cancel/.Error). Root is context-aware — headless when given a `reviews` array (client-side filter/sort/paginate), otherwise it fetches summary + paginated reviews for a product (explicit `productId` or the ambient Product context) via the sveltekit-medusa-sdk reviews remotes, with optimistic display of just-submitted reviews. Render-prop children expose { reviews, summary, count, page, pageCount }; parts read a surface-neutral ReviewsListContext, so other surfaces (e.g. Customer.Reviews) reuse them. No $effect (SSR-safe).

name: product
title: Product
description: Compound Product primitives (Root, Title, Subtitle, Description, Price, Options, OptionButton, QuantitySelect, Rating, JsonLd) over a Medusa StoreProduct. Rating renders the product's aggregate star summary from the sveltekit-medusa-sdk reviews remote (re-exporting Star from the `review` atom) and JsonLd emits schema.org Product/AggregateOffer markup. URL-driven variant selection (?v= links), inventory-aware option availability (manage_inventory/inventory_quantity), currency-aware price with sale strikethrough, sanitized {@html} description. Pure resolution logic in product-logic.ts; no $effect (SSR-safe). Fetch the product reactively in your route and pass it in.

name: cta
title: CTA
description: Add-to-cart primitives wired to the sveltekit-medusa-sdk cart remotes. AddToCartButton resolves variant/quantity from Product context (or props), shows pending/aria-busy state and an accessible inline success/error message, with optional post-add redirect. AddToCartToggle reflects cart membership for a variant/condition via a checkbox (or a custom children snippet). StripeExpressCheckout renders Stripe's Express Checkout wallet button (Apple Pay / Google Pay / Link) in deferred mode for product cards and landing pages — Medusa-agnostic: you create the PaymentIntent in onConfirm and call the supplied confirm(clientSecret). All flat exports; no compound namespace.

name: cart
title: Cart
description: Compound Cart primitives (Root, Trigger, Badge, Sheet, Items, Item, Image, Title, Price, Quantity, Remove, ItemSubtotal, Subtotal, Empty, Checkout) plus a CartDrawer preset, wired to the sveltekit-medusa-sdk cart remotes. Reactive re-render on cart changes with onupdate/onremove/onerror callbacks and pending-state disabling; per-part class override; self-contained currency-aware format-price. No $effect (SSR-safe). Badge shows total quantity and hides at 0.

name: address
title: Address Form
description: Compound Address primitives (Root, Email, FirstName, LastName, Phone, AddressLine1, AddressLine2, City, Company, Country, PostalCode, Autocomplete, Province, BillingToggle, Billing) plus AddressForm and AddressFormCollapsed presets. Owns cart writes via the sveltekit-medusa-sdk cart remotes (DI-with-SDK-default + onaddresschange/onregionchange/onerror callbacks): debounced updateCart, region-by-country switching, billing same-as-shipping toggle, and Google Places autocomplete (optional; degrades to text). Receives the consumer's remote form (renders no <form>). No $effect (SSR-safe; hydrates via onMount).

name: checkout
title: Checkout
description: Compound Checkout primitives (Root, Items, Item, Image, Title, Price, Quantity, ItemSubtotal, Remove, Delivery, Discount, Summary + 7 summary rows, PlaceOrder, Confirmation, CheckoutError) with payment parts for both providers — BraintreePayment/BraintreeHostedFields and StripeElements/StripePayment/StripeAddress — plus three batteries-included presets: CheckoutBraintree (hosted fields), CheckoutStripe (Payment Element / card fields), and CheckoutAuto (renders whichever provider the cart's region is configured for, from region.payment_providers). Each preset owns the <form>, composes the Address preset alongside a single-page cart summary, and calls placeOrder (updateAddress → shipping guard → authorizePayment → completeCart) with a StoreOrder confirmation or redirectTo. Return is a standalone handler for redirect-based Stripe methods (iDEAL, Bancontact, giropay, Przelewy24) — drop it on the route your returnUrl points at. Wired to the sveltekit-medusa-sdk cart/checkout/braintree/stripe remotes (DI-with-SDK-default); no $effect (SSR-safe).

name: auth
title: Auth
description: Compound login/register/forgot/reset forms (a createAuthForm factory + Field/Label/Input/Error/Submit parts) plus an Auth.Dialog preset (URL-driven ?auth= modal with a per-part classes map); wired to the sveltekit-medusa-sdk auth remotes; SSR-safe, no $effect.

name: customer
title: Customer
description: Storefront shopper identity: SignedIn/SignedOut auth-state gates, Menu/MenuTrigger/MenuContent/MenuItem over the shadcn DropdownMenu, SignInButton (deep-links ?auth=login), and SignOut; plus Customer.Reviews — the shopper's own reviews across all products, composed from the `reviews` collection parts (List/Sort/Pagination) with Review.Product, Review.Edit, and Review.Delete. Reads the sveltekit-medusa-sdk customer & reviews remotes directly.

name: theme-button
title: Theme Button
description: Icon button that toggles light/dark via mode-watcher. Resizable, with overridable sun/moon icons.

name: theme-toggle
title: Theme Toggle
description: Toggle that reflects and flips the light/dark theme via mode-watcher. Overridable icons + label.

name: theme-switch
title: Theme Switch
description: Bare switch that toggles light/dark via mode-watcher. Optional additive form binding for settings forms.

name: theme-select
title: Theme Select
description: Bare light/dark/system dropdown driving mode-watcher's userPrefersMode. Optional additive form binding.

name: google-places-autocomplete
title: Google Places Autocomplete
description: Address autocomplete field wrapping Google's PlaceAutocompleteElement, themed with shadcn tokens (chrome stripped, dropdown restyled). Emits a normalized address on select; no store writes.

name: input-text
title: Input Text
description: Text/email/tel/number/password/textarea field bound to a SvelteKit remote-form field proxy, wrapped in shadcn Field with label + validation errors.

name: input-select
title: Input Select
description: Native select bound to a SvelteKit remote-form field proxy with data-driven options, wrapped in shadcn Field with label + validation errors.

name: input-select-country
title: Input Select Country
description: Country select bound to a remote-form field: takes a `countries` list (the Address family feeds it the store's regions) and renders ISO-2 code values with country names as labels. Exports the `Country` type. Extends input-select.

name: input-postal-code
title: Input Postal Code
description: Postal-code text field that uppercases as you type (alphanumeric postcodes) and bubbles the change. Extends input-text.

name: input-province
title: Input Province
description: Config-driven province/state field bound to a remote-form field: renders a select when the current country is configured (default US + CA, ISO 3166-2 values), otherwise a freeform text input. Ships US_STATES, US_MILITARY (APO/FPO), CA_PROVINCES, defaultProvinceConfig, and the resolveProvince helper; stores extend per country in one place. Extends input-select + input-text.
